receipt.public_excerpt: Of the 526 annotated sentences, 240 (45.7%) of the sentences were labelled major-inaccurate, 158 (30.0%) were minor-inaccurate, and 128 (24.3%) were accurate.

evidence_items.explanation: The original March report evaluates GPT-3 text-davinci-003 on 65 generated biographical passages and finds substantial factual fabrication. These are task-specific measurements, not an error rate for all LLM answers.

receipt.public_excerpt: We’re working with partners to integrate Claude with sources of solid, real-time information, like those found in search engines such as DuckDuckGo.

evidence_items.explanation: External-source integration was already a practical approach to factual applications. This limits any broader reading that LLMs could not contribute to factual systems, but supplies no measured accuracy establishing dependable standalone generation.

unresolved_gaps: The independent evaluation covers one model and a biographical-generation task, not a representative sample of every factual use.
